subject: goldfish
title: What If You Kept a Goldfish in a Bowl?

scenes.text: What if you kept a goldfish in a bowl? The bowl isn't too small yet.
Within days, its waste builds up as ammonia, which is toxic, with no filter to break it down.
Low oxygen follows. A goldfish gulping at the surface is struggling to breathe.
Its outside stops growing, but its organs keep going, which can bend its spine or push out its eyes.
In a bowl, most live a year or two. In a big filtered tank or pond, ten to thirty years.
A goldfish can grow past half a meter, and one lived to 43. It's too small for the fish it could become.

description:
What if you kept a goldfish in a bowl? Without a filter, ammonia from its waste builds up and oxygen drops, and its body can stop growing while its organs don't.
In a bowl most goldfish live a year or two; in a large filtered tank or pond they can live 10 to 30 years, grow past half a metre, and one reached 43.
